note: Statuses are engineering tracking claims, not proof of device acceptance. Do not set verified without linked real-device evidence, human review, and required signoffs.

gates.details: macOS 14.2 Sonoma native H.264 screen-only MP4 path has user-reported capture success; validate playable, seekable repeated 15s/early-stop and system-audio recordings with FFprobe and QuickTime. This is not Program output.

Merged moving Mac video preview and interactive source transforms; bounded composed MP4 with session-scoped early stop and 30s cap is under review. Sustained timestamped native 1080p30 Program output and mixed display/video scenes remain unverified.
Mac capture card/webcam moving preview and source geometry merged; static overlay diagnostic exists. Mixed display/video and scene-transition parity and real-device output remain unverified.

Mac named HDMI/mic/desktop PCM mix and live meters merged; optional AAC in bounded Program capture. Real audible audio, source clock drift, live fader adjustment during capture and Windows audio remain unverified.

Native Media Foundation synthetic H.264 MP4 encoding and H.264/AAC encrypted local RTMPS encoding and independent decoding passed in CI. Real Windows Graphics Capture, physical microphone/HDMI, long-duration recording and lip-sync remain unverified.

Developer-only explicit native RTMPS acceptance path and native H.264/AAC synthetic loopback with independent decoder passed on macOS ARM64, macOS Intel and Windows x64 (PR #93); independent offline receiver soak file verifier merged (PR #94). Real capture-device and external private receiver interoperability, physical lip-sync, reconnect and two-hour soak, independent security review and production Go Live remain pending. Synthetic evidence is not physical acceptance.
Secure OS keychain stream-key storage and public API authorization/TLS are incomplete; API must remain loopback-only.
Mac Developer ID notarization, Windows Authenticode signing, 30-minute A/V recording QA and 2-hour stream QA have not passed; Android debug APK excluded from desktop beta scope.
